g.text: Tracking layer: wide- and medium-field infrared sensors detect and track missiles
Transport layer: mesh of optical inter-satellite links, Ka-band and Link 16 to forces
Proliferated LEO: hundreds of satellites at ≈ 1 000 km, replaced in two-year 'tranches'
